hero.caption: Photograph of the town of Saltville taken by RebelAt in August, 2006. The stone building with the steeple near the center is Madam Russell Memorial United Methodist Church. The long building at far left is the Food Country shopping center.  The red brick building with the tall chimney at the far right is Northwood High School. Note the row of nearly-identical houses left-of-center, located between the Madam Russell United Methodist Church and Food Country, which were constructed by the Olin Corporation to house employees.
